01 / About

Engineering intelligence
into useful systems.

I’m an MS student in Artificial Intelligence & Business Analytics at the University of South Florida with a computer science background. I’m most interested in the point where machine learning meets engineering: reliable data, reproducible models, real-time systems, and products people can actually use.

My work spans ML, data engineering, MLOps, analytics, computer vision, and applied AI. I’ve worked with satellite imagery for supply-chain intelligence, built streaming and batch data platforms, developed full-stack AI applications, and translated community data into decision-support analytics.
